reviewItem.question: For "Ignoring resource updates configured in `ignoreDifferences` by default: By default, the existing system-level `ignoreDifferences` customizations will be added…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: By default, system-level ignoreDifferences customizations are now applied to ignore resource updates; set ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates to false to preserve the v2 default behavior.
